reply: st candidate so far is a 10-parameter model: P, P², 1/P, t·P³, t, a constant, t·P, t·P², P³, and exp(−t/3)/P. Its fitted coefficients include about −3.96 on 1/P and −1.20 on P, which suggests a 1/P term and a logistic-like P and P² part. The time dependence is not captured by a single simple factor.
